reviews.title: 好玩
reviews.text: 好怀念西游手游，太棒了

reviews.title: Just boring
reviews.text: I got tired of logging in to play through more levels due to account level requirements. It’s a good game overall and wish the best of luck to the dev team

reviews.title: Some improvement suggestion
reviews.text: The game is very enjoyable and well-polished, both in terms of visuals and content. It would be great to improve the image sharpness and increase the resolution of the characters’ skill effects. Keep up the great work and continue developing the game! Very good!

reviews.title: Haven’t started game fully but rerolls are fast and has no lag
reviews.text: I haven’t started the game fully since I’ve been rerolling and it’s been like my 7th reroll, even with internet connection being bad since I’m outside, i finished in 5 minutes. I don’t know why some people are saying tutorial is so long, they just not be focusing on the tutorial or not clicking 2x speed when your able to. Rerolls or tutorial finishes are very fast and haven’t lagged me out once

reviews.title: Please resolve the lag
reviews.text: Good game but it lags a lot and it’s only the second day after launch.

reviews.title: Annoying tutorial
reviews.text: Why is the tutorial so long and that I have no chance to turn of the volume. I was trying to watch a video and play this but it truly was ten times louder I could barely hear my video. It is so annoying

reviews.title: Downloaded and stuck on loading screen
reviews.text: Game doesn’t even work. After downloading it asks if I want to allow notifications and is just stuck at a loading screen but there’s no bar or anything. Deleting and redownloading also doesn’t fix.

reviews.title: One thousand pull
reviews.text: Why I can’t use the 1000 free pull?  It keeps asking me to buy a pass.  Shouldn’t the pull be free?

reviews.title: Great game.
reviews.text: This is a great game. It was my whole childhood. I think you guys should add Vietnamese language.
